label: Couple (teenagers)
description: Who a teenage couple is: a teenage boy and girl, two teenage girls or two teenage boys. Each value stands for the couple value it is tagged with (the pair facet).
notes: Seeds a couple's variants in place of person.couple, by the same shares, when the couple reads as teenagers (the who rule's stages): they are written as a boy and a girl, never a man and a woman. Not a slot's list.
